visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with short black hair wearing a white crewneck t-shirt sits in a modern indoor bedroom setting. He faces the camera, speaking with active facial expressions. In front of him, he holds a smartphone displaying a digital invitation for an Apple event with a glowing blue apple logo. (2) He shifts his position toward a dark brown suitcase on the bed behind him. He opens a mesh compartment and retrieves two slim blue stick packs. He holds these packs close to the camera, showcasing the branding 'JoeJoe Probiotics'. (3) A product showcase shot displays a blue box of 'JoeJoe Probiotics' next to a small wooden bowl containing fine brown powder. (4) The man is shown in a medium shot, tearing open one of the blue packs and pouring the powder directly into his mouth. He then chews and swallows while looking at the camera. (5) Returning to the initial seated position, he continues talking while gesturing with the two blue stick packs in his hand. (6) A large graphic overlay appears on the screen, featuring a blue background with yellow and white text listing membership day prices and a 48-hour time limit. The man remains visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear, professional male voice begins speaking with high energy and clarity over a light, melodic lo-fi pop BGM featuring a steady electronic beat. The vocal pitch is moderate and the tone is inviting. (2) A sharp mechanical click and sliding sound of a zipper occur as the speaker mentions packing. The BGM remains constant in the background. (3) A distinct plastic rustling sound is heard as the speaker retrieves the product stick packs. The narration continues at a fast, conversational pace with clear articulation. (4) A short, crisp tearing sound of foil/plastic occurs as the speaker opens a pack. The BGM maintains its tempo and volume. (5) The speaker's voice continues with rising intonations as he explains the product benefits and promotional offer. A subtle 'pop' sound effect accentuates a graphic appearance. The BGM continues until the track ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Personal Context -> Product Introduction -> Functional Benefits -> Promotional Details -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote 'JoeJoe Probiotics' by leveraging the creator's upcoming travel to the Apple event as a relatable context for needing digestive health support. It aims to drive immediate sales during a 48-hour '99 Membership Day' flash sale.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator introduces the product as 'his own probiotics', demonstrates consumption, explains technical benefits (20 billion bacteria, 10 patent strains), and presents a direct pricing promotion for '99 Membership Day'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-trust influencer marketing strategy, connecting a high-interest event (Apple launch) with a personal health routine to sell a private label product.
